Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 1) Alcohol withdrawal commonly presents with:
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.option2: Retrobulbar neuritis and red-green colour defect
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.option4: Anxiety, tremor, hallucinations, agitation and seizures
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: Alcohol withdrawal may cause anxiety, tremor and agitation. Hallucinations and seizures may occur in severe cases. Prompt recognition is important because it can be dangerous.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 2) Drug used for treatment of alcohol withdrawal is:
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: Benzodiazepines are used for alcohol withdrawal. They reduce agitation and seizure risk. Dose and monitoring depend on severity.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 3) Barbiturate and benzodiazepine withdrawal resembles:
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: Barbiturate and benzodiazepine withdrawal can resemble alcohol withdrawal. Symptoms may include tremor, agitation and seizures. Abrupt stopping after prolonged use is risky.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 4) Management of benzodiazepine withdrawal includes:
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.option3: Switch to long-acting benzodiazepine and taper slowly
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: Benzodiazepines should not be stopped abruptly after long-term use. A long-acting benzodiazepine may be used. Then dose is gradually tapered.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 5) Glucocorticoid withdrawal may cause:
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: Steroid withdrawal can cause adrenal insufficiency. Symptoms include weakness, fatigue, nausea, vomiting and hypotension. Hypoglycaemia may also occur.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 6) Prevention of glucocorticoid withdrawal is by:
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: Long-term glucocorticoids suppress adrenal function. Gradual tapering allows adrenal recovery. Steroid replacement may be needed if adrenal insufficiency occurs.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 7) Opioid withdrawal commonly causes:
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.option4: Rhinorrhoea, yawning, lacrimation, diarrhoea and dilated pupils
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: Opioid withdrawal causes autonomic and GI symptoms. Rhinorrhoea, yawning and lacrimation are typical. Dilated pupils and diarrhoea are useful clinical clues.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 8) Treatment of opioid withdrawal may include:
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: Methadone is a long-acting opioid agonist. It can be used to manage opioid withdrawal. It reduces withdrawal symptoms and helps stabilization.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 9) SSRI withdrawal may cause:
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.option3: Dizziness, nausea, sweating, insomnia and nightmares
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: SSRI withdrawal can cause dizziness and nausea. Sweating, insomnia and nightmares may occur. Gradual dose reduction reduces risk.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 10) SSRI withdrawal is reduced by:
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: SSRIs should be reduced gradually when stopping. Abrupt discontinuation increases withdrawal symptoms. Slow tapering improves tolerability.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 11) Peptic ulcer may be drug-induced by:
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: NSAIDs can damage gastric mucosa. Corticosteroids may also contribute to ulcer risk. Combined use increases gastrointestinal risk.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 12) Drug-induced parkinsonism is commonly caused by:
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: Antipsychotics can block dopamine receptors. This may cause parkinsonism. Phenothiazines are classic causative drugs.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 13) Drug-induced lupus erythematosus is classically caused by:
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: Hydralazine is a classic cause of drug-induced lupus. Symptoms may resemble systemic lupus. Stopping the offending drug is important.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 14) Drug-induced gout may be caused by:
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: Thiazides can increase uric acid. They may precipitate gout. This is a common diuretic-related metabolic adverse effect.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 15) Which anti-TB drug can cause drug-induced gout?
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: Pyrazinamide can cause hyperuricaemia. It may precipitate gout. Ethambutol is also listed among gout-causing drugs.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 16) Which immunosuppressant is listed as a cause of drug-induced gout?
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: Ciclosporin can contribute to gout. It is listed with aspirin, nicotinic acid, thiazides and pyrazinamide. Drug history is important in new gout attacks.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 17) Nicotinic acid may cause:
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: Nicotinic acid is listed among drugs causing gout. It may increase uric acid. This adverse effect matters in patients with gout history.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 18) Chlorpromazine can cause which hepatotoxicity pattern?
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: Chlorpromazine is associated with cholestasis. High-dose oestrogens are also listed under cholestasis. Pattern recognition helps identify likely causative drugs.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 19) High-dose oestrogens are associated with:
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: High-dose oestrogens may cause cholestasis. Chlorpromazine is another example. Cholestatic symptoms may include jaundice and pruritus.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 20) Co-amoxiclav is associated with:
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: Co-amoxiclav can cause cholestatic hepatitis. NSAIDs and statins are also listed in this pattern. Drug-induced liver injury can present with jaundice and raised liver enzymes.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 21) Which drug group is associated with cholestatic hepatitis?
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: NSAIDs are listed under cholestatic hepatitis. Co-amoxiclav and statins are also included. They may also cause gastrointestinal and renal adverse effects.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 22) Statins are associated with:
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: Statins are listed under cholestatic hepatitis. Liver enzyme monitoring may be needed in selected patients. Muscle toxicity is another important statin issue, though not the focus here.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 23) Rifampicin and isoniazid are associated with:
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: Rifampicin and isoniazid can cause acute hepatitis. Liver function monitoring is important in symptomatic patients. Hepatotoxicity is a key adverse effect of anti-TB therapy.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 24) Amiodarone is associated with:
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: Amiodarone is listed under non-alcoholic steatohepatitis. It has multiple important toxicities. Long-term therapy needs careful monitoring.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 25) Busulfan and azathioprine may cause:
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: Busulfan and azathioprine are associated with venous outflow obstruction. This is a specific hepatotoxicity pattern. Azathioprine also requires FBC and LFT monitoring.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 26) Methotrexate may cause hepatic:
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: Methotrexate can cause hepatic fibrosis. It requires LFT monitoring. Long-term toxicity risk increases with dose and patient risk factors.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 27) Nitrofurantoin may cause:
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: Nitrofurantoin is listed under autoimmune hepatitis-like injury. It is also a caution drug in G6PD deficiency. Drug history is important in unexplained hepatitis.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 28) Checkpoint inhibitors such as nivolumab and pembrolizumab may cause:
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: Checkpoint inhibitors may trigger immune-mediated hepatitis. Nivolumab and pembrolizumab are examples. The pattern may resemble autoimmune hepatitis.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 29) Which is the best matched pair?
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: Hydralazine is a classic cause of drug-induced lupus. Chlorpromazine causes cholestasis. Methotrexate causes fibrosis, and pyrazinamide may cause gout.

Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.question: 30) Which is the best matched pair?
Drug withdrawal, drug induced disease.exp: Co-amoxiclav is associated with cholestatic hepatitis. Busulfan may cause venous outflow obstruction. Nitrofurantoin may cause autoimmune hepatitis-like injury.
